cards.name: Battle with Walpurgisnacht, Homura
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at up to two cards from the top of your deck, choose a card from among them, and put it on top of your deck. Put the rest into your waiting room.

cards.name: Common Wishes, Sayaka & Kyoko
cards.text: 【CONT】 During your opponent's turn, this card gets +500 power for each of your other 《Magic》 characters.

cards.name: A Lonely Fight, Homura
cards.text:
【CONT】 If you do not have any other characters, this card gets +1 level and +1500 power.
【AUTO】【CLOCK】 Shift, Level 0 (At the beginning of your main phase, you may choose a green card in your hand and this card in your clock, and exchange them.)

cards.name: Smiling Sayaka
cards.text:
【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this unit get +X power. X is equal to 500 multiplied by the number of characters you have with "Assist".
【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room] （When this card is put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, return this card to its previous stage position as 【REST】)

cards.name: Ordinary Girl, Madoka
cards.text: 【CONT】 Assist All of your characters in front of this card get +500 power.

cards.name: Nurse's Aide, Madoka
cards.text: 【AUTO】[(1)] When this character attacks, if a card named "The Girl from the Dream" is in your climax area, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a character in your clock, return it to your hand, and put the top card of your deck into your clock.

cards.name: Madoka Kaname
cards.text:
【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.
【AUTO】 When this card is placed on stage from your hand, all of your characters get +2000 power until end of turn.
【ACT】[(1)] This card gets +2000 power until end of turn.

cards.name: Homura Akemi
cards.text:
【CONT】 If the number of cards in your stock is four or less, this card gets +500 power, and gets "【AUTO】 Encore [Put a character from your hand into your waiting room]".

【CONT】 The character facing this card gets -1 soul.

cards.name: Law of the Cycle
cards.text: Search your deck for up to one 《Magic》 character, reveal it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.

cards.name: I won't rely on anyone anymore!
cards.text:
【CONT】 All of your characters get +1000 power and +1 soul.


(: When this card triggers, return this card to your hand. Put the top card of your deck into your stock)

cards.name: The Girl from the Dream
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card is placed on your climax area from hand, put the top card of your deck into your stock, and all of your characters get +1 soul until end of turn.

cards.name: Kyosuke Kamijo
cards.text: 【AUTO】 When this card attacks, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Second-year of Mitakihara Middle School, Sayaka
Magical Girl of Swords, Sayaka
cards.text: 【ACT】【COUNTER】 Backup 2000, Level 1 [(1) Put this card from your hand into your waiting room] (Choose one of your characters that is being frontal attacked, and that character gets +2000 power until end of turn)

cards.name: Ally of Justice, Sayaka
cards.text: 【CONT】 If the number of other 《Magic》 characters you have is three or more, this card gets +1000 power.

cards.name: Miracles and magic are real
cards.text: 【CONT】 All of your characters get +2 soul.
